name: Waldorf Astoria Park City
positioning: Ski resort hotel in Canyons Village, steps from the Frostwood Gondola to Park City Mountain, with fireplaces in every room, suite and residence
best_for: Skiers who want gondola access to Park City Mountain and a shuttle to Deer Valley Resort
Families or groups wanting residences with full kitchens

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Frostwood Gondola for skiing Park City Mountain.
The hotel runs a complimentary shuttle to Deer Valley Resort.
Many of the accommodations include furnished balconies, soaking tubs and full kitchens.
Rooms in natural colors have custom furnishings and views of the ski slopes and Wasatch Mountains.
Dining is modern alpine cuisine made from seasonal ingredients, with artisanal cocktails, curated wines and locally distilled spirits.
An outdoor patio has fire pits near the heated pool and whirlpools.
Curated outdoor pursuits in the Wasatch Mountains include hiking, fly-fishing and mountain biking.
The hotel was formerly the Dakota Mountain Lodge, at the base of Canyons Resort.
Event venues framed by the Wasatch Mountains host meetings and celebrations.

highlights.text: The resort is in Canyons Village, with ski-in, gondola-out access to Park City Mountain in winter.
Every room, suite and residence has its own fireplace.
Bi-level residences have an upstairs primary bedroom overlooking a living room with mountain views.
The resort has a year-round heated pool and hot tubs.

considerations.text: Winter access to Park City Mountain is ski-in, gondola-out: guests ride the Frostwood Gondola up rather than skiing out from the door.
Deer Valley Resort is reached on the hotel's complimentary shuttle, not from the hotel door.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing year-round.
